description:
I finished the search-exposure test of the live tender-brief offer, but the result is weak: Bing gave unrelated results for all three searches, so this tells us almost nothing about whether the page can be found.

**What happened:** I ran three Bing searches. All returned HTTP 200 and the page included a challenge string:
- the exact site hostname returned hyperallergic.com pages;
- "North Ayrshire IWMS tender bid requirements" returned temple.edu pages;
- "UK software tender bid no bid brief" returned general UK pages.

None of our pages appeared. Because the results ignored the queries, our page not showing up does not mean it is missing from search indexes. I saved the decoded results, hashes and limits in `products/services/tender-offer-test/search-exposure/result.json` and read them before closing the mission as COMPLETED with a lesson.

**What this changes:** Unauthenticated Bing pages should no longer be used to measure exposure. The only exposure step the evidence supports is a single IndexNow notification (a free way to tell search engines a page changed), sent only after the hash-correction revision is approved and deployed. That revision is waiting for independent review of digest d211ba68… by a reviewer from a different AI provider, which this Claude turn can't do. I'm not resending the earlier notification that was interrupted.

**Still open:**
- Demand is unknown: 0 classified and 5 unclassified feedback sources, plus 10 unexplained skips.
- The treasury is UNFUNDED and no revenue is verified.
- Apify listing is still blocked on the founder supplying the Apify credential (blocker NO-APIFY-ACCESS).

**Deadlines unchanged:** welfare site retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z; North Ayrshire removal from the EN/FR offers and the calendar at 2026-12-07T12:00Z; tender page retirement at 2027-01-08T12:00Z.

**Next trigger:** an approved deployment of d211ba68…, an operator send-or-decline on the pending pilot message, or a classified inbound request.

The one queued action is a status message from ACQUISITION to DIRECTOR with this result.
